name: futurelot
description: Property-specific zoning answers for US homeowners: ADUs, home additions, pools, new homes and multi-family.

interface.shortDescription: What can you build on your lot
interface.longDescription:
Find out what you’re allowed to build on a US property. Give FutureLot an address to explore a backyard cottage or in-law apartment (ADU), a home addition, a pool, a new home, or multifamily housing.

FutureLot checks the parcel, zoning district, and lot details, then explains the rules for your project using local zoning and applicable state laws. Understand size limits, parking requirements, rental restrictions, and more—in plain language. You can also ask about a city’s ADU rules before choosing a property.

Each answer distinguishes what zoning allows from what needs a site-specific review. Follow the link to FutureLot to see setbacks and try a project on your lot.

All you need is an address. No account or device location required.
defaultPrompt: Can I build a backyard cottage at 78 Audubon Drive, Newton, MA?
How big an addition can I build at 78 Audubon Drive, Newton, MA?
What are the rules for building an ADU in Pasadena, CA?

positive.description: Detached ADU (backyard cottage) on a covered property
positive.prompt: Can I build a backyard cottage at 78 Audubon Drive, Newton, MA?
positive.expected_behavior: Detached ADU allowed by right in zone SR3: maximum floor area 1,000 sq ft, footprint 851 sq ft, one ADU per lot, conditions such as the 30-day minimum rental. The "Try a backyard cottage" button opens the property on FutureLot on the backyard cottage page.

positive.prompt: How big an addition can I build at 78 Audubon Drive, Newton, MA?
positive.expected_behavior: Home addition looks feasible: maximum added floor area 1,518 sq ft and footprint 851 sq ft; the "Plan your addition" button opens the home additions page.

positive.prompt: Can I put a pool at 78 Audubon Drive, Newton, MA?
positive.expected_behavior: A pool is allowed by right in zone SR3 as an accessory structure and looks feasible on the lot, with the principal-structure setbacks as the main constraint; the "Place your pool" button opens the pool page.

positive.description: Project the zone does not allow
positive.prompt: Can I build a duplex at 78 Audubon Drive, Newton MA?
positive.expected_behavior: Multi-family is not allowed in zone SR3 and the 8,481 sq ft lot is below the 43,560 sq ft minimum; the answer says so plainly and links to the multi-family page.

positive.description: A city's ADU rules without a property
positive.prompt: Are ADUs allowed in Newton, MA?
positive.expected_behavior: City-wide ADU rules for Newton in plain language (detached and internal ADUs by right, 1 ADU per lot, 30-day minimum rental) with a link to the city page, and no parcel-specific numbers.

negative.description: Distance between two addresses: a mapping question, not what can be built, so FutureLot should not be called and the assistant answers on its own.
negative.prompt: How far is 78 Audubon Drive, Newton, MA from 1 Main St, Boston, MA?

negative.description: Event tickets at an address: FutureLot does not sell tickets or know about events, so it should not be called.
negative.prompt: Buy me theater tickets for the show at 270 Tremont St, Boston, MA.

negative.description: Reviews of a business at an address: not a zoning question, so FutureLot should not be called.
negative.prompt: What are the reviews for the restaurant at 1 Main St, Boston, MA?

review.commerce_description: FutureLot does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Answers are free and link to the property page on app.futurelot.com.

publication.release_notes: First release. Four read-only tools: find_property, get_adu_feasibility, get_project_feasibility and get_city_rules, answering from the same anonymous property report a visitor sees on futurelot.com without an account.
